author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager
job_description:
Lab49 is an award winning specialist consultancy that creates bespoke technology in partnership with the most important companies in finance.

We were founded in 2002 to bring Silicon Valley solutions to Wall Street’s door. Since then, we have worked on successive waves of technological change, including distributed computing, high-speed automation, enterprise UX and digital distribution (for which Lab49 was among the first significant practices established on Wall Street), DevOps, cloud and data science.

Today, we are an established partner in financial markets, having delivered hundreds of projects for clients including all the world’s tier-one investment banks and many of the largest buy-side firms globally.

Being part of Lab49 means bringing your drive and creativity into an environment where your contributions will make immediate impact. Engineers work in cross functional teams, consulting directly with our clients, shaping not only technical solutions to business problems but delivering them into production.

We are seeking a Product Manager, who will be working with our clients in the high frequency trading space. One who has the ability to communicate and collaborate effectively with engineers, designers, HR professionals and other stakeholders; .

### **Responsibilities**

* Communication and Collaboration Skills: Ability to communicate and collaborate effectively with engineers, designers, HR professionals and other stakeholders; should be comfortable facilitating discussions and working on cross-functional teams.
* Process Design: Lead sessions to understand current state processes and pain points; leverage this analysis and understand key requirements to help shape the future state process design and gain alignment across HCM and business stakeholders.
* Analytical Skills and Data Acumen: Strong analytical skills to interpret data, identify trends, and support data-driven decision-making. They should be comfortable working with spreadsheets and other reporting tools to analyze data.
* Requirements gathering and documentation acumen: Ability to gather, document and clearly articulate product requirements (i.e., user stories, data migration requirements, etc.).
* Technical Aptitude: Candidate should have a basic understanding of software development principles and be comfortable working with technical teams.
* Test Strategy & Execution: Work with functional and technical teams to shape the end-to-end testing strategy, spanning functional test and UAT; help test solution rigorously (along with HCM and business stakeholders) to surface and resolve critical defects ahead of a program’s launch
* Project & Change Management: Help project manage key deliverables, while helping execute against an innovative communication and training strategy – from drafting stakeholder messaging to creating high-quality learning collateral
* Understanding of Total Rewards Concepts (optional – specific to Rewards pillar): A foundational understanding of total rewards principles, including compensation structures, benefits packages (health, retirement, etc.), and other employee benefits is ideal.
* Oracle Core experience (optional): Foundational knowledge and understanding of Oracle HRIS including data management, system optimization and functionality

**Why Lab49?**

Lab49 is an established partner for most financial institutions on Wall Street. You will gain exposure into a variety of environments, business domains, technologies, and people. Your ability to bring drive and creativity to the role will be the key component to success at Lab49. The broad and intense exposure to a variety of challenges accelerates your career growth, and Lab49’s structure is designed to enable you to learn and grow as an engineer and consultant.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
**Description**
---------------

Role Objective: The Group Product Manager (GPM) – Marketing will be responsible for developing and executing marketing strategies for assigned product portfolios. The role involves market analysis, brand planning, product lifecycle management, and collaboration with cross-functional teams to drive product growth, market share, and profitability. Principal Tasks & Responsibilities Key Responsibilities 1. Brand Strategy & Planning Develop and implement marketing strategies for assigned brands/products. Prepare annual brand plans and promotional strategies aligned with business objectives. Monitor brand performance and take corrective actions to achieve targets. 2. Market Analysis Conduct market research to understand market trends, competition, and customer insights. Analyze prescription trends, sales data, and competitor activities. Identify opportunities for product growth and market expansion. 3. Product Lifecycle Management Manage product lifecycle including product launches, positioning, and growth strategies. Plan and execute new product launches in coordination with cross-functional teams. 4. Promotional Activities Design and implement promotional campaigns, marketing materials, and brand communication. Develop visual aids, promotional inputs, and digital marketing initiatives for field force effectiveness. 5. Field Force Engagement Work closely with the sales team to ensure effective product promotion. Conduct training sessions for field force on product knowledge and marketing strategies. Provide regular updates and guidance to improve field performance. 6. Stakeholder Collaboration Coordinate with Medical, Regulatory, Sales, Supply Chain, and Finance teams to ensure smooth product operations. Engage with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and healthcare professionals for brand advocacy. 7. Budget Management Manage marketing budgets and ensure cost-effective utilization. Monitor ROI of marketing activities. Key Skills & Competencies Brand growth and market share Achievement of sales targets Successful product launches Effectiveness of promotional campaigns Field force productivity and engagement

title: Associate Product Manager, University Graduate, 2027 Start
job_description:
This role will begin accepting applications on October 30, 2026, targeting cohort starts between April and August 2027*.* You must complete your application \*before\* end of day on November 24, 2026 to be considered. Thank you in advance for your patience while our team reviews all applications. All applicants will be notified by the end of Spring 2027 with an update.

* + In the “Resume" section, attach an updated CV or resume. No cover letter needed.
  + In the “Higher education" section, fill out the fields accordingly and select “Now attending or Graduated” under "Degree status." Then, upload a current or recent unofficial or official transcript in English.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Currently enrolled in or graduated from a degree program within Product Management, Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Internship or Teaching Assistant experience in product management, software development or a similar technical field.
* Experience leading entrepreneurial efforts or outreach within organizations while building cross-functional relationships.
* Experience preparing and delivering technical presentations to an audience through internships, coursework, or extracurriculars.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience with methodologies aimed to drive product development and delivery.
* Experience applying Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning (AI/ML) concepts to build products or features through relevant internship, capstone projects, or other academic work.
* Technical experience with programming languages, data analysis, business case/modeling, pricing, or design.
* Ability to start full-time in the primary cohort onboarding cycle between April and August 2027.
* Ability to communicate in English fluently to support cross-functional business relationships in the region.
* Excellent problem-solving, organizational, investigative, and critical thinking skills.

**About the job**
-----------------

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  
  
In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.  
  
One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

Google aims to build products that organize the world's information and make it universally accessible to our users. As a Product Manager at Google, you could be working on new technologies, platforms, consumer facing products, and/or enterprise systems. The end goal will be to match you with the team that best aligns with your interests, experience, and where you will have the most impact.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Understand markets and user requirements in depth.
* Launch products and features, test their performance, and iterate quickly.
* Work collaboratively with Engineering, Marketing, Legal, and User Experience (UX) on technologies.
* Develop innovative solutions to problems by collaborating as needed across regions, product areas, and functions.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager, Enterprise Solutions
job_description:
As a Product Manager in the APAC Products' cross-functional team, you will work on enabling AI-powered experiences for Enterprise customers, helping businesses transform how they engage with their audiences through intelligent solutions. This role is strategically important as you will shape the future of AI-enabled enterprise products in India/APAC. You will define new models for building, launching, and scaling AI-driven solutions that help enterprises automate workflows, personalize customer interactions, and unlock new business opportunities. You will partner with engineering, design, data science, and business teams to deliver meaningful AI-powered product experiences for enterprise clients. The team operates with close proximity to APAC markets, fostering strong partnerships. Expect a collaborative, people-centered environment with experienced teammates who value mentorship and knowledge sharing.This position offers a opportunity to shape AI-enabled enterprise products at global scale while being rooted in one of the world's most dynamic regions. If you're excited by bringing cutting-edge AI capabilities to enterprise customers and driving real business transformation, you'll thrive here.  
  
  

### **Product Manager, Enterprise Solutions Responsibilities:**

* Define and execute product roadmaps for AI-enabled enterprise experiences, including automation tools, intelligent workflows, and personalization capabilities
* Identify and drive consensus for how to prioritize and realize the most significant opportunities in your product area
* Lead cross-functional collaboration across engineering, design, data science, sales, and partnerships to deliver integrated solutions
* Drive go-to-market strategy for enterprise AI products in APAC markets, with potential for global expansion
* Scale AI best practices (including responsible AI use), workflows, and artifacts across product teams so the organization's capabilities compound over time
* Support the growth of other PMs and cross-functional team members by providing mentorship and coaching on AI-native practices
* Communicate product strategy and progress clearly and consistently to all stakeholders

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 8+ years of Product Management experience
* 3+ years experience leading AI/ML product initiatives at scale (enterprise or B2B preferred)
* APAC market experience, as the role supports enterprise product strategy and go-to-market efforts across APAC markets
* Track record shipping products that drove measurable business outcomes for enterprise customers
* Experience developing and scaling AI-native strategies including evals and data strategies across teams
* Experience navigating complex, multi-stakeholder environments and influencing without authority

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.  
  
  
  
  
  
  
Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.

Role - Senior Product Manager || Job Location - Bangalore
  
  
About the Role
  
  
We are looking for a dynamic and experienced Product Manager / Senior Product Manager – AI to lead the strategy, development, and implementation of AI-driven products that transform customer and merchant experiences across our payments ecosystem. The role will work closely with Engineering, Data Science, Compliance, and Business teams to develop next-generation solutions powered by large language models (LLMs) and other generative AI technologies.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Define and drive the roadmap for generative AI capabilities across our product suite, including fraud detection, customer support automation, and personalised payment experiences.
  
Work cross-functionally with AI/ML Engineers, Data Scientists, UX Designers, and business stakeholders to build, launch, and iterate on AI-powered features.
  
Identify customer pain points and develop AI-first product solutions that improve efficiency, security, and user engagement.
  
Evaluate third-party LLM platforms, including OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google, and work with internal teams to integrate them securely and effectively.
  
Monitor product performance using data and customer feedback, and use insights to optimise AI models and user interactions.
  
Ensure that all AI product developments comply with applicable financial regulations and data privacy laws, including RBI and GDPR requirements.
  
  
Required Qualifications
  
  
3–5 years of product management experience, including at least 1+ year of experience in AI products; experience in payments or fintech is highly preferred.
  
Strong understanding of generative AI models, including LLMs, transformers, and embeddings, and their applications in real-world products.
  
Proven track record of shipping B2C or B2B AI/ML-driven products at scale.
  
Strong analytical, strategic-thinking, and communication skills.
  
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment with regulatory sensitivity.
  
  
Nice to Have
  
  
Experience with prompt engineering and fine-tuning LLMs.
  
Background in Data Science, Machine Learning, or Software Engineering.
  
Familiarity with payment ecosystems, risk modelling, and fraud analytics.

title: Senior Staff Product Manager - AI Agents (Migration & Onboarding)
job_description:
**Overview**
------------

Come join the QuickBooks Desktop team (part of Mid-Market Segment) as a Senior Staff Product Manager, AI Migration & Onboarding Agent.

QuickBooks is Intuit's flagship accounting software, powering millions of small and mid-sized businesses globally. The Mid-Market team is driving a critical transformation: migrating customers from Desktop to cloud-native platforms.

Today, migration from desktop to cloud is high-friction and high-touch. It slows conversion and strains support capacity. Your mission is to change that by building an AI Agent that guides customers through the entire migration journey, from readiness assessment to data migration, configuration, and first productive use.

This is a zero-to-one role. You will own the vision, strategy, and execution for this agent, working at the intersection of LLMs, agentic architectures, and accounting domain knowledge to turn migration from a barrier into a growth engine.

**Responsibilities**

* Own the AI Migration Agent end-to-end: Define vision, strategy, and roadmap for an AI agent that guides customers through complex product migrations, from readiness assessment through post-migration validation.
* Design for scalability and reuse: Architect the agent as a modular platform capability that can be extended to multiple source systems, customer segments, and net-new onboarding journeys.
* Define AI/Human collaboration: Design patterns where the agent handles routine tasks autonomously and escalates complex decisions to domain experts, support teams, or customers.
* Build the knowledge backbone: Own the agent's knowledge base, including product mapping logic, feature parity data, gap analysis rules, and domain-specific reasoning.
* Drive adoption and migration velocity: Define success metrics (completion rate, time-to-value, CSAT, support deflection) and build feedback loops to continuously improve agent performance.
* Lead cross-functional execution: Align engineering, AI/ML, design, data science, sales, care, and operations around an agent-first migration strategy. Partner with platform teams to leverage shared AI infrastructure.
* Close the customer insight loop: Research migrating customers, domain experts, and internal teams to uncover friction points and benchmark against AI-driven migration experiences in SaaS and Fintech.

**Qualifications**

* Experience: 10+ years in product management with 2+ years shipping AI agent, conversational AI, or intelligent automation products in B2B SaaS or Fintech.
* AI Agent expertise: Deep understanding of agentic architectures, LLMs, RAG systems, orchestration frameworks, and evaluation pipelines. Experience defining guardrails, confidence thresholds, and human-in-the-loop escalation patterns.
* B2B SaaS Migration experience: Track record building customer migration, data portability, or onboarding products. Understands the complexity of moving business-critical data between systems at scale.
* Platform thinking: Designs modular, reusable agent capabilities that serve multiple source systems, customer segments, and journey types.
* Customer empathy: Deep experience with SMB/mid-market customers. Understands the friction and anxiety customers face when switching business-critical software.
* Analytical rigor: Comfortable defining and tracking agent performance metrics like accuracy, task completion, escalation rate, and time-to-value.
* Cross-functional influence: Proven ability to align engineering, AI/ML, design, and GTM teams around a shared product vision in a matrixed organization.
* Education: Undergraduate degree required (technical discipline preferred). MBA or advanced degree is preferred.

Preferred

* Hands-on experience with LLM-based agent frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or equivalent).
* Familiarity with prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and AI evaluation techniques.
* Experience in accounting, ERP, or financial software domains.
* Top-Tier or International MBA or other Advanced degree preferred.

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product manager
job_description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

  

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

**About the Team & Role**

Expedia Group’s Payments team is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the traveler payment experience, covering how travelers discover, select, and use payment methods at checkout. You’ll set strategy, prioritization, and experimentation for payment selection, flexibility, authorization performance, and recovery across web, mobile web, and native apps. The role blends deep payments expertise with AI product judgment to make payments simple, transparent, and trusted at global scale. You’ll partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Finance, Risk, Legal, Operations, and brand teams.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

  

* Define and execute the product vision and roadmap for payment selection, payment method presentation, payment flexibility, and checkout interactions.
* Own the payment marketplace experience: decide which methods (cards, wallets, BNPL, local payment methods, installments) to surface, where, and for whom, by traveler, market, device, and trip context.
* Improve checkout conversion by removing friction across payment entry, authentication, authorization, error handling, retries, and recovery.
* Build a rigorous experimentation program, from hypothesis and A/B testing through measurement and scaled rollout of winners.
* Define and deliver AI capabilities such as personalized payment recommendations, intelligent routing, failure prediction, next-best-action recovery, and anomaly detection, partnering with Data Science and Engineering on model evaluation, explainability, privacy, bias, and safe rollout.
* Partner with Payments platform teams to ensure reliable, scalable, reusable capabilities across pay-in, authentication, orchestration, and payment status.
* Use quantitative and qualitative insights (conversion, payment and authentication success, support contacts, customer feedback) to prioritize opportunities and measure impact.
Balance traveler experience against cost, authorization performance, fraud and risk, regulatory needs, and operational efficiency, while aligning multiple EG brands and communicating strategy, risks, and decisions to senior leaders.  

**Minimum Qualifications**

  

* 8 + years of product management experience, with a strong track record building, scaling, or transforming payment products.
* Expert knowledge of the payments ecosystem: payment methods, PSPs, authorization and declines, 3DS, tokenization, wallets, routing, refunds, and failure recovery.
* Proven success designing and optimizing high-converting checkout and payment-selection experiences across web, mobile web, and native apps, using experimentation, analytics, and customer research.
* Experience applying AI/ML to customer-facing products (personalization, decisioning, fraud prevention, optimization), with practical understanding of model evaluation, explainability, privacy, bias, and responsible rollout.
Excellent communication and ability to lead through influence in a matrixed organization, with strong analytical skills, product judgment on trade-offs, and a bias toward measurable outcomes.  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Experience in travel, ecommerce, marketplaces, fintech, or other high-scale transactional businesses.
* Experience with payment orchestration, merchant-of-record models, payment performance optimization, or payment method expansion.
* Experience taking AI-powered products from problem definition and model evaluation through launch, monitoring, and measurable business impact.
* Familiarity with payment economics (processing costs, FX, rebates, routing, vendor performance) and global delivery across local payment methods, currencies, and regulations.
* Experience building products across multiple brands, regions, or business models, and improving post-booking payment experiences (payment updates, scheduled payments, failure recovery, payment status).

**Accommodation requests**

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job\_accommodation .

  

**About Expedia Group**

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

  

**Important notice**

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/ .

  

**Equal Opportunity**

Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

* 8 + years of product management experience, with a strong track record building, scaling, or transforming payment products.
* Expert knowledge of the payments ecosystem: payment methods, PSPs, authorization and declines, 3DS, tokenization, wallets, routing, refunds, and failure recovery.
* Proven success designing and optimizing high-converting checkout and payment-selection experiences across web, mobile web, and native apps, using experimentation, analytics, and customer research.
* Experience applying AI/ML to customer-facing products (personalization, decisioning, fraud prevention, optimization), with practical understanding of model evaluation, explainability, privacy, bias, and responsible rollout.
Excellent communication and ability to lead through influence in a matrixed organization, with strong analytical skills, product judgment on trade-offs, and a bias toward measurable outcomes.  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Experience in travel, ecommerce, marketplaces, fintech, or other high-scale transactional businesses.
* Experience with payment orchestration, merchant-of-record models, payment performance optimization, or payment method expansion.
* Experience taking AI-powered products from problem definition and model evaluation through launch, monitoring, and measurable business impact.
* Familiarity with payment economics (processing costs, FX, rebates, routing, vendor performance) and global delivery across local payment methods, currencies, and regulations.
* Experience building products across multiple brands, regions, or business models, and improving post-booking payment experiences (payment updates, scheduled payments, failure recovery, payment status).

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job\_accommodation .

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/ .

  

**Equal Opportunity**

Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

**Additional Locations:** India-Haryana, Gurgaon

**Diversity - Innovation - Caring - Global Collaboration - Winning Spirit - High Performance**

At Boston Scientific, we’ll give you the opportunity to harness all that’s within you by working in teams of diverse and high-performing employees, tackling some of the most important health industry challenges. With access to the latest tools, information and training, we’ll help you in advancing your skills and career. Here, you’ll be supported in progressing – whatever your ambitions.

**Location:**

Gurgaon

**About the position:**

Manage the commercial performance of the business from the point of view of revenue, market share and profitability. With additional inputs for strategic and Tactical planning, Project management, Product Life cycle management, Business Analytics, Budgeting and forecasting experience.

**Primary Job Functions:**

  

* Developing and implementing marketing plans for the country according to overall Urology plan and budget.
* Portfolio Strategy & business development planning
* Leading Product Launch and Life Cycle Management in collaboration with sales leadership, local and APAC/global cross-functional stakeholders.
* Analysis of competitor activities, customer needs, technology and infrastructure, therapy adoption etc. and implement Campaigns to drive Portfolio as per division’s goals.
* Engaging with internal and external stakeholders to facilitate and further the achievements of business goals.

**Job Responsibilities**

  

* Strategically managing all aspects of internal and external marketing strategy
* Conceptualize and Lead execution of marketing plans for Urology as per Business goals and budgets, coordinate with internal functions, customers and external service providers, monitor on ground execution of programs/ conferences/ events/ promotions etc the right set of metrics are in place for tracking success.
* Planning and implementing Product launches and Product life cycle management.
* Monitoring sales performance and effectiveness of marketing programs against goals set.
* Product Life cycle management and working with cross functional teams to drive product approvals, inventory planning and product availability as per portfolio marketing plans.
* Conduct analysis of competitor activities, customer needs, technology and infrastructure, therapy adoption
* Development of key marketing communications for portfolio, works closely with agencies and media to develop right messaging and its delivery, tracking the effectiveness of the communication to drive differentiation.
* Establish relationships with KOLs in the field, Drive KOL and customer engagement
* Conduct investigative research to assess brand image, market share and growth opportunities.

**Must Have:**

  

* MBA in marketing
* 5+ Years of exp is required in Medical devices and marketing. Experience of working in marketing / product management function.
* Candidate should have handled some product launches independently
* Strong interpersonal communication skills, written and presentation skills and the ability to manage multiple programs at once and effectively prioritize work are essential.
* Candidate should have experience in Product marketing & Digital marketing
* Proficiency in excel, power point and Microsoft tool
* Candidate with Sales experience or experience in Urology will be a preference but not a limitation
* Experience of working, interacting with KOLs / physicians.
* Experience of working with cross functional teams – finance, sales, regulatory, legal in a corporate environment
* Travel requirement approx. 7-10 days a month.

* Own and manage the product backlog, ensuring features, initiatives, and user stories are clearly defined, refined, and prioritized.

* Define product roadmaps and priorities aligned with HNW (High Net Worth) business objectives and technology strategy.

* Collaborate with Business, Product, Technology, and other stakeholders to understand requirements, dependencies, and expected outcomes.

* Translate business needs and opportunities into actionable product requirements and measurable outcomes.

* Ensure end-to-end validation of delivered capabilities against business requirements and expected outcomes.

* Provide regular product updates, insights, and recommendations to senior stakeholders and leadership.

* Drive continuous improvement by incorporating feedback and lessons learned into future product planning and delivery.

1. Life / Wealth Insurance Domain  
2. Product Backlog Management  
3. Stakeholder Management & Collaboration  
4. Agile Execution & Product Delivery  
5. Process Improvement & Metrics

* Graduate degree in B.E. / B.Tech. from a reputed university.

* 8–12 years of relevant professional experience.

* Proven experience in Product Management, product delivery, backlog management, or a closely related role.

* Experience working in Agile environments with cross-functional business and technology teams.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager
job_description:
Avam is an applied and materials sciences company developing biology, chemistry, and materials science products for testing, research, manufacturing, and cleaner energy applications. Working at the intersection of science and product development, the team focuses on bringing technically rigorous products to market that support customers across a range of scientific and industrial use cases.

This Product Manager role will help shape how Avam’s scientific product portfolio evolves to meet customer needs and market opportunities. You will work closely with technical and commercial partners to guide product direction, align priorities, and support decisions that balance scientific depth with business impact.

### **Responsibilities**

* Define product strategy and roadmap for Avam’s scientific product portfolio.
* Set priorities for Avam’s products and customer experiences, aligning the work with the organization’s mission and goals.
* Gather input from visitors, staff, and other stakeholders to understand needs and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Develop clear product plans, goals, and timelines, and keep work moving from idea through launch.
* Coordinate with teams across the organization to plan, deliver, and improve products, programs, or services.
* Define how success will be measured and track results such as customer feedback, participation, revenue, or other agreed-upon goals.
* Use research and performance data to recommend changes and guide future product decisions.
* Manage product budgets, schedules, and competing requests; raise risks or resource needs early.
* Keep stakeholders informed about priorities, progress, decisions, and results.
* Ensure products and experiences are accessible, consistent with Avam’s values, and useful to the people they serve.
* Document product decisions, processes, and lessons learned to support ongoing improvement.

  
**Requirements**  

* Bachelor's degree or higher.
* 4+ years of product management experience in biotechnology or life sciences.
* Experience managing scientific products from discovery through commercial launch.
* Strong ability to translate technical concepts into actionable product requirements.
* Experience with scientific product areas or technical environments such as biotech research tools, diagnostics, lab instrumentation, manufacturing workflows, and cleaner-energy materials applications.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional collaboration across research, engineering, manufacturing, and commercial teams.
* Reliable high-speed internet connection for remote work.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Non-Labor Product Manager, Reporting
job_description:
PFI Innovation Centre India is an exciting new organization. We’re building a future that helps people live better lives longer – and we’re looking for bold thinkers and team players to help us do it.

Here, you’ll tackle complex challenges, collaborate with brilliant minds across the globe, and grow your career while helping millions achieve financial security.

**A PURPOSE DRIVEN COMPANY – 150 YEARS**

While the PFI Innovation Centre brand is new to India, you’ll be a part of the Prudential Financial, Inc. family. Founded in Newark, NJ, we serve 50 million customers across more than 50 countries. With $1.334 trillion in assets, we’re a global leader in institutional asset management. The 2nd largest life insurer in the US and the 9th largest institutional global asset manager.

At the PFI Innovation Centre India, you’ll find high-performance culture that’s flexible, collaborative, and grounded in respect. We engage with candor, take calibrated risks, and hold ourselves accountable – always focused on delivering for our customers. It’s the standard we choose every day as we grow, perform, and win as one team. We offer valuable leadership, mentoring and learning opportunities, paired with flexibility and support to help you thrive.

Whether you’re just starting out or ready to take your next step, we’ll help you grow with purpose and do the best work of your career.

**Non-Labor Product Manager, Reporting**

**What you will do:**

Are you excited by the intersection of financial planning, real estate, technology expense, and category governance? Join PFI Innovation Centre India as a Non-Labor Product Manager, Reporting. You will lead end-to-end planning, forecasting, reporting, and governance for the Non-Labor Technology, Properties, and Other expense categories, applying sound accounting judgment and partnering with Newark stakeholders to resolve complex category issues. The role is based in India and reports to the Director, Expense Management; the employee work arrangement will be confirmed during the hiring process.

**What you can expect:**
------------------------

* Lead knowledge transfer, dual-run, and stabilization of the expense processes transitioning to PFI Innovation Centre India, stabilizing, and continuously improving.
* Own the forecasting model and reporting tools for the expense category, building quarterly forecasts and delivering quarterly management reporting, overseeing forecast quality, planning assumptions, financial controls, and variance analysis.
* Provide real estate and lease-accounting judgment to support accurate planning and financial reporting.
* Analyze category performance, key variances, and risks, translating findings into management insights.
* Partner with Newark Expense Management and respective product teams to clearly document requirements and ensure accurate, timely and complete financials.
* Serve as data domain owner for Non-Labor Technology and Properties and Other expense data, ensuring data quality, consistent definitions, and governance.
* Drive reporting standardization, stronger governance, and continuous improvement across non-labor expense processes.
* Gather end-user feedback to prioritize and implement enhancements to expense planning and reporting.

**What you will bring:**
------------------------

* Experience in properties, facilities, occupancy, and Non-Labor Technology expense management, including planning and forecasting.
* Strong financial reporting, expense analytics, and variance-analysis capabilities.
* Knowledge of financial controls, governance, and data-quality practices.
* Demonstrated stakeholder management, complex issue-resolution, and process-improvement skills.
* Ability to apply accounting judgment to complex real estate and lease matters.
* Experience with capitalization of fixed assets and technology, including the related accounting and reporting.
* Lease, real estate, fixed assets, and technology accounting experience under US GAAP and US STAT.
* Experience working across global and matrixed finance teams.

**What will set you apart?**

* Experience transitioning finance processes into a GCC, shared services, or global delivery environment and stabilizing them to steady state.
* Experience leading, coaching, and talent development.

* **PFI Innovation Centre India welcomes all applicants, even if you don't meet every requirement. If your skills align with the role, we encourage you to apply.**

  

**Skills:** Financial Reporting , Expense Management , Data Governance

job_description:
Product Management

Navi Mumbai (On-Site)

Associate, Mid-Senior

3-6 years

Fulltime

  

Job Description

**JD: Associate Product Manager (APM) / Product Manager (PM) | Small Hybrid Vertical**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Department:** Product Management

**Location:** Navi Mumbai

**Reports To:** Senior Product Manager

  
  

### **About Us**

At **ideaForge Technology**, we are pioneering the future of autonomous flight. We design, manufacture, and deploy cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) that solve complex challenges across industries—from defence, homeland security and infrastructure inspection to emergency response and delivery.

  
  

### **Role Summary**

As an Assistant Product Manager (APM) / Product Manager (PM) for the Small Hybrid Verticals portfolio within the Switch UAV family, you will own the product lifecycle, strategy, and market performance for this critical product line. You will report to the Senior Product Manager and operate as a leader within the product management function, bridging customer demand (defense, paramilitary, state agencies) with engineering capability, manufacturing constraints, and regulatory certification requirements.

This role blends strategic product development with hands-on execution across requirements, regulatory alignment (DGCA, FCC, BlueUAS Certification), business planning, and cross-functional team leadership. You will drive the product roadmap from market research through production at scale, managing trade-offs between performance, cost, compliance, and customer needs.

  
  

### **Key Responsibilities**

  
  

### **Product Strategy & Roadmap Ownership**

* Develop and execute the multi-year product roadmap for Small Hybrid Verticals. Define product variants, performance tiers, and feature evolution across the Switch family. Work with engineering leadership to balance feature requests, technical feasibility, development timelines, and manufacturing capacity.

* Drive business cases for new initiatives (new variants, payload integrations, airframe configurations). Forecast revenue, unit economics, and market penetration for roadmap milestones.

### **Customer & Market Intelligence**

* Conduct ongoing market research across Indian defense buyers (Army Aviation, BRO, state police, paramilitary forces) and international defense bodies. Translate customer pain points and operational requirements into product requirements documents (PRDs).

* Lead competitive analysis of global and domestic UAV platforms operating in similar tactical niches. Track competitor capabilities, pricing, go-to-market strategies, and certifications.

* Support sales and business development teams with tender responses, feature positioning documents, and pricing justification. Participate in customer demonstrations and technical discussions to validate requirements.

### **Regulatory Certification & Compliance Leadership**

* Own the regulatory certification pathway for Small Hybrid Verticals through DGCA Type Certification and international regulatory bodies (FAA, EASA, etc.). Coordinate with certification teams, external agencies, and technology partners.

* Ensure product design, documentation, and testing align with aviation regulations. Prepare certification-readiness reports and mitigate compliance risks early in the development cycle.

* Manage dependencies with external regulatory bodies and escalate blockers to senior leadership.

### **Cross-Functional Program Leadership**

* Lead integrated product development programs with hardware (airframe, propulsion, avionics), electronics, software, and manufacturing teams. Facilitate requirements clarity, dependency tracking, and milestone achievement.

* Chair product review meetings, design reviews, and launch readiness gates. Escalate technical risks and resolve trade-offs between cost, performance, and timeline.

* Mentor junior product team members and interns. Provide guidance on requirements gathering, market analysis, and business case development.

### **Cost, Pricing & Business Performance**

* Conduct cost-of-goods analysis for Small Hybrid Verticals. Build bottom-up cost stacks including BOM, labor, overhead, and manufacturing yield. Identify cost-reduction opportunities across design, sourcing, and manufacturing.

* Define pricing strategy and margin targets in alignment with MoD procurement patterns, competitive positioning, and profitability objectives.

* Track product P&L, unit economics, and market performance against forecast. Provide monthly/quarterly business reviews to senior leadership.

* Experience with configurable products, workflows, platforms, APIs or integrations.

* Experience in HRTech / ATS is a plus
* Good communication skills and ability to work with customers and cross-functional teams.

title: Lead Digital Product Manager –Web and Mobile Banking
job_description:
**About the Role:**

We are seeking a Lead Digital Product Manager to join our Wholesale Digital Core experience Web and Mobile organization.

This role will be instrumental in transforming web core and mobile experiences for our Commercial, Corporate, and Investment Banking clients. The successful candidate will define and lead complex, enterprise‑scale digital initiatives that deliver delightful, frictionless, secure, and consistent mobile experiences, while leveraging Generative AI, machine learning, and data‑driven insights to shape the next generation of customer engagement.

**In this role, you will:**

  

* Lead the development and execution of complex digital business plans, programs and initiatives which have impact across the enterprise with broad impact
* Act as key participant in large-scale planning
* Review and analyze complex digital strategy for product/functionality/experience area
* Influence digital strategy for the business line requiring in-depth evaluation of multiple factors including intangibles or unprecedented factors
* Make decisions in digital strategy for product/functionality/experience area requiring strong understanding of the business, policies, procedures and/or compliance requirements
* Lead a broad team of digital professionals to meet deliverables and drive new initiatives
* Strategically collaborate and consult with peers, colleagues and mid-level to senior managers to resolve issues and achieve goals
* Potentially lead projects, teams or serve as a peer mentor

**Required Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of digital product management experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education.
* Experience leading large‑scale digital or mobile transformation initiatives.
* Experience in financial services, preferably in Commercial and Corporate Banking digital transformation. Working knowledge of Foreign Exchange and Capital Markets in wholesale banking preferred.
* 5+ years of product development experience in web and mobile applications across platforms and form factors.

**Desired Qualifications:**

  

* Demonstrated experience delivering products powered by Generative AI or machine learning, including conversational or search‑based interfaces.
* Deep understanding of user‑centered design and rapid prototyping (wireframes, prototypes, experimentation).
* Hands‑on experience with Agile practices such as Scrum and Kanban; proficiency with tools including Jira, Confluence, and SharePoint.
* Entrepreneurial mindset—bias for experimentation, learning, and speed while operating in a regulated environment.

**Job Expectations:**

* Autonomous, high ownership, and demonstrates strong learning agility
* Strategic yet hands‑on; comfortable navigating ambiguity
* Strong business, technical, and data acumen

**Posting End Date:**

3 Nov 2026

* ***Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.***

**We Value Equal Opportunity**

Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit’s risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements.

Candidates applying to job openings posted in Canada: Applications for employment are encouraged from all qualified candidates, including women, persons with disabilities, aboriginal peoples and visible minorities. Accommodation for applicants with disabilities is available upon request in connection with the recruitment process.

**Applicants with Disabilities**

To request a medical accommodation during the application or interview process, visit Disability Inclusion at Wells Fargo.

**Drug and Alcohol Policy**

Wells Fargo maintains a drug free workplace. Please see our Drug and Alcohol Policy to learn more.

**Wells Fargo Recruitment and Hiring Requirements:**

a. Third-Party recordings are prohibited unless authorized by Wells Fargo.

b. Wells Fargo requires you to directly represent your own experiences during the recruiting and hiring process.

c. Please be prepared to provide accurate information and supporting documentation in connection with any lawful employment and education verification conducted by Wells Fargo.

title: Senior Product Manager - Data Integrations
job_description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

* *Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.*

**An overview of this role**
----------------------------

As a Senior Product Manager for Data Integrations, you'll help GitLab's analytics and artificial intelligence (AI) agents see beyond the data held in GitLab. You'll decide which external systems connect to the Data Insights Platform and Orbit, which integrations come first, and how their data fits into shared models.

Engineering teams plan work, track incidents, monitor production, and manage security findings across different tools. Your challenge is to bring that context together with GitLab's code, merge requests, pipelines, deployments, and vulnerabilities. You'll shape a consistent approach that gives customers a trustworthy picture they can query, report on, and use with agents, rather than another set of disconnected data sources.

This role is based in Bangalore, India. You'll work from home and come to the Bangalore office when needed for business or team activities. You should be based in Bangalore or willing to relocate there.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Set integration priorities using evidence from customers, field teams, and other product managers to identify the biggest gaps in context.
* Shape how external data maps into GitLab's shared data models, including the extract, transform, and load (ETL) approach and the transformations needed to make sources work together.
* Define the customer problems and user groups each integration serves. Partner with engineering to agree on the intended experience, trade-offs, and delivery sequence.
* Translate product decisions into a clear backlog of epics and issues for engineering.
* Define telemetry and adoption signals to understand whether connected data helps customers answer new questions, and use those findings to guide priorities.
* Help shape integration pricing and packaging as the product area matures.
* Use AI coding agents and GitLab to explore data, prototype integrations, and document the intended experience.

**What you'll bring**
---------------------

* Product management experience, with the ability to connect customer needs to priorities and make trade-offs with incomplete information.
* Strong knowledge of the software development and operations (DevOps) ecosystem, including how planning, security, observability, and IT service management tools fit into engineering workflows.
* A working understanding of data integration, ETL, and data transformation, including how data from different systems maps to a common model. You don't need a background as a data engineer.
* Comfort using AI tools for prototyping and documentation as part of your product work.
* Clear communication about customer problems, close collaboration with engineering, and a habit of using data to evaluate adoption.
* Experience with integration products, data models, or value stream analytics is helpful, but isn't required.

**About the team**
------------------

We're part of GitLab's Core Data Products organization, which focuses on insights, analytics, and data-driven decision-making. You'll report to the Vice President of Product Management and join as our third product manager, focused on Data Integrations. You'll work alongside a Principal Product Manager responsible for the Data Insights Platform and dashboards, and a Product Manager focused on Orbit.

GitLab is all-remote, with asynchronous collaboration across regions. Transparency, written communication, and clear decisions are central to how we work. This role has the Bangalore location and in-person requirements described above.

#### **How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees**

* Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
* Flexible Paid Time Off
* Team Member Resource Groups
* Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Growth and Development Fund
* Parental Leave

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

**Country Hiring Guidelines:** GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.

**Privacy Policy:** Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.

GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Technical Product Manager
job_description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

As a Senior Technical Product Manager for AI Products & Solutions, you'll set the vision and roadmap for AI-powered products and run delivery for them. These include generative AI copilots, agentic digital workers and intelligent automation used across healthcare operations such as claims, prior authorization, member, provider operations and care administration. You'll work with engineering, data science, architecture and business leaders to turn complex problems into AI solutions that are safe, scalable and measurable.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Product vision and strategy: Set and own the vision, strategy and multi-quarter roadmap for AI/GenAI products, tied to business goals and enterprise AI priorities
* Problem discovery: Work with business stakeholders to find high-value AI use cases, assess whether they're feasible, and build business cases with clear ROI, savings and capacity metrics
* Backlog ownership: Turn strategy into epics, features and user stories with clear acceptance criteria. Prioritize the backlog by value, risk and dependencies
* AI solution design: Work with data scientists, ML/LLM engineers and architects on model selection, prompt and agent design, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), evaluation frameworks and human-in-the-loop workflows
* Delivery leadership: Lead agile delivery across scrum teams from idea through POC, pilot, UAT and production, including release planning and go-live readiness
* AI and compliance: Make sure solutions meet
* AI principles, privacy rules (HIPAA, PHI/PII), security and model governance, including bias, explainability and auditability
* Measurement: Define and track product KPIs such as adoption, accuracy, automation rate, cycle-time reduction, cost savings and FTE capacity. Use the data to improve the product
* Stakeholder management: Present status, risks and outcomes to executive leadership. Build alignment across technology, operations and business teams
* Adoption and change management: Drive enablement through demos, office hours, documentation, FAQs and feedback loops
* Market awareness: Keep up with trends in GenAI, agentic AI, LLMOps and AI platforms, and bring in new ideas and reusable patterns
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a related field (or equivalent experience)
* 10+ years in technology, including 5+ years in product management or technical product ownership
* Experience managing AI/ML, GenAI or intelligent automation products from concept to production
* Hands-on experience with Agile/Scrum/SAFe and tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Rally or Aha!
* Proven experience building business cases and reporting outcomes to senior leadership
* Solid understanding of LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, AI agents, model evaluation and MLOps/LLMOps concepts
* Proven ability to translate business needs into technical requirements and to work credibly with engineers and data scientists
* Proven excellent written and verbal communication, storytelling and stakeholder management skills
* Preferred Qualifications:
* Master's degree or MBA
* Certifications such as CSPO, SAFe POPM, PMP or AI/ML certifications
* Experience in US healthcare (payer, provider or PBM), such as claims, utilization management, prior authorization or provider data
* Experience leading distributed, global teams

**Key Competencies:**

* Strategic thinking
* Customer focus
* Data-driven decisions
* Technical depth in AI
* Executive communication
* Collaboration
* Comfort with ambiguity
* Responsible innovation

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

As a Senior Technical Product Manager for AI Products & Solutions, you'll set the vision and roadmap for AI-powered products and run delivery for them. These include generative AI copilots, agentic digital workers and intelligent automation used across healthcare operations such as claims, prior authorization, member, provider operations and care administration. You'll work with engineering, data science, architecture and business leaders to turn complex problems into AI solutions that are safe, scalable and measurable.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Product vision and strategy: Set and own the vision, strategy and multi-quarter roadmap for AI/GenAI products, tied to business goals and enterprise AI priorities
* Problem discovery: Work with business stakeholders to find high-value AI use cases, assess whether they're feasible, and build business cases with clear ROI, savings and capacity metrics
* Backlog ownership: Turn strategy into epics, features and user stories with clear acceptance criteria. Prioritize the backlog by value, risk and dependencies
* AI solution design: Work with data scientists, ML/LLM engineers and architects on model selection, prompt and agent design, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), evaluation frameworks and human-in-the-loop workflows
* Delivery leadership: Lead agile delivery across scrum teams from idea through POC, pilot, UAT and production, including release planning and go-live readiness
* AI and compliance: Make sure solutions meet
* AI principles, privacy rules (HIPAA, PHI/PII), security and model governance, including bias, explainability and auditability
* Measurement: Define and track product KPIs such as adoption, accuracy, automation rate, cycle-time reduction, cost savings and FTE capacity. Use the data to improve the product
* Stakeholder management: Present status, risks and outcomes to executive leadership. Build alignment across technology, operations and business teams
* Adoption and change management: Drive enablement through demos, office hours, documentation, FAQs and feedback loops
* Market awareness: Keep up with trends in GenAI, agentic AI, LLMOps and AI platforms, and bring in new ideas and reusable patterns
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a related field (or equivalent experience)
* 10+ years in technology, including 5+ years in product management or technical product ownership
* Experience managing AI/ML, GenAI or intelligent automation products from concept to production
* Hands-on experience with Agile/Scrum/SAFe and tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Rally or Aha!
* Proven experience building business cases and reporting outcomes to senior leadership
* Solid understanding of LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, AI agents, model evaluation and MLOps/LLMOps concepts
* Proven ability to translate business needs into technical requirements and to work credibly with engineers and data scientists
* Proven excellent written and verbal communication, storytelling and stakeholder management skills
* Preferred Qualifications:
* Master's degree or MBA
* Certifications such as CSPO, SAFe POPM, PMP or AI/ML certifications
* Experience in US healthcare (payer, provider or PBM), such as claims, utilization management, prior authorization or provider data
* Experience leading distributed, global teams

**Key Competencies:**

* Strategic thinking
* Customer focus
* Data-driven decisions
* Technical depth in AI
* Executive communication
* Collaboration
* Comfort with ambiguity
* Responsible innovation

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager, Senior A
job_description:
**About the role**

As the world’s leading provider of AI-powered solutions for social impact, Blackbaud is looking for a Senior Product Manager to help build the platform foundation for understanding how customers adopt and get value from our solutions. You’ll partner with Platform leadership and a dedicated engineering team to deliver shared capabilities that produce trustworthy usage and outcomes data, giving Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams clearer insight to improve adoption, engagement, and retention. Through strong product judgment, data-driven learning, and cross-functional collaboration, you’ll help teams replace one-off approaches with scalable capabilities, expanding what’s possible for the purpose-driven people and organizations Blackbaud serves.

**What you'll do**

* Own the backlog and product lifecycle for platform capabilities serving engineering and analytics teams, from discovery and validation through delivery and adoption.
* Partner with engineering to build the standards, tools, and guidance product teams need to instrument solutions and publish trustworthy usage data to Blackbaud’s data platform.
* Drive adoption of shared capabilities across the portfolio by understanding product and engineering teams’ needs, supporting onboarding, and helping teams retire one-off approaches.
* Connect platform capabilities to meaningful outcomes by partnering with Customer Success and other internal consumers to understand how usage data can better support their needs.
* Translate strategy, customer insight, data, and stakeholder input into clear requirements, acceptance criteria, documentation, assumptions, and decisions that keep work moving.
* Define hypotheses and success measures, then use adoption, data quality, and feedback to test assumptions and continuously improve the capabilities you own.
* Use AI tools and modern product practices to accelerate discovery, requirements definition, and delivery while proactively communicating progress, risks, decisions, and tradeoffs across distributed teams.

**What you'll bring**

* 5+ years of Product Management experience, ideally including technical product management for internal platforms, developer tools, or data products.
* Demonstrated experience delivering platform capabilities where engineering or analytics teams are the primary consumers.
* Hands-on experience with product analytics tools such as Heap, Mixpanel, Amplitude, or Pendo, including event taxonomy and instrumentation design.
* Working knowledge of SQL and modern data platforms; experience with Databricks, medallion data modeling, or Azure data services is a plus.
* Familiarity with web application instrumentation and privacy and consent requirements related to analytics data.
* Experience using agile development practices and tools such as Azure DevOps to deliver products across cross-functional teams.
* Experience turning incomplete information into forward progress by establishing outcomes, testing assumptions with data and feedback, and working effectively across distributed teams and time zones.

Stay up to date on everything Blackbaud, follow us on Linkedin, X, Instagram, Facebook and YouTube

Blackbaud powers social impact through purpose‑driven technology and responsible AI. Guided by our *Intelligence for Good®* vision, we’re building a culture where innovation, trust, and human expertise come together to help organizations make a greater difference in the world.

Blackbaud is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to maintaining an inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, physical or mental disability, age, or veteran status or any other basis protected by federal, state, or local law.

job_description:
**Product Manager**

**Location: Pune, India (Work from home)**

  

**Role Overview**

The Product Manager is responsible for defining and delivering regulatory-compliant, scalable, and data-driven risk management solutions, including Customer Risk Rating (CRR) and Transaction Monitoring (TM) capabilities. This role serves as the bridge between Compliance, Risk, and Engineering, ensuring that products meet regulatory expectations while enabling efficient and effective operational workflow. As a Product Owner within our global compliance department, you will lead systems projects to support product or regulatory needs, developing product backlog and user testing efforts and consistently meeting project deadlines while completing thorough documentation and information sharing throughout.

  

**You will be responsible for:**

* Translating high-level complex business requirements into Agile Epics, Features and User-Stories.
* Creating UX designs, flowcharts, story boards and diagrams to support the Features and User-Stories
* Own and prioritize the product backlog, balancing compliance needs, technical constraints, and delivery timelines
* Ensuring regulatory authority and user architecture needs are followed while acting as a liaison between business operations, support departments such as Product, Compliance and Security, and Engineering.
* Performing user acceptance testing and supporting system implementation
* Identifying and recommending improvements to management.
* Create and Maintain process and procedures guides.

  

**You should apply if you have:**

* Bachelor's degree preferred, with 7-10 years of experience as a Product Owner / Sr. Business Analyst.
* Strong understanding of financial crime compliance (AML, KYC, transaction monitoring) is preferred.
* Demonstrated experience as a Product Owner with track record of delivering comprehensive Epics, Features and User-Stories, as well translating business requirements into technical requirements.
* Experience with creating UX design solutions through wireframes, visual and graphic designs, flow diagrams, storyboards, site maps, and prototypes.
* Experience with data analysis, including writing SQL queries will be an asset.
* Project management experience/knowledge with ability to drive projects to successful completion.
* Experience in complex retail/consumer financial services/case management/ payment services organizations is desired but not mandatory.
* Strong interpersonal, analytical, problem-solving, influencing, prioritization, decision making and conflict resolution skills.
* Ability to interact and communicate effectively, orally & in writing, with all levels of management.

  

**About Convera**

Convera is the largest non-bank B2B cross-border payments company in the world. Formerly Western Union Business Solutions, we leverage decades of industry expertise and technology-led payment solutions to deliver smarter money movements to our customers – helping them capture more value with every transaction. Convera serves more than 30,000 customers ranging from small business owners to enterprise treasurers to educational institutions to financial institutions to law firms to NGOs. Our teams care deeply about the value we bring to our customers, which makes Convera a rewarding place to work. This is an exciting time for our organization as we build our team with growth-minded, result-oriented people who are looking to move fast in an innovative environment. As a truly global company with employees in over 20 countries, we are passionate about diversity; we seek and celebrate people from different backgrounds, lifestyles, and unique points of view. We want to work with the best people and ensure we foster a culture of inclusion and belonging.

**We offer an abundance of competitive perks and benefits including:**

* Competitive salary
* Opportunity to earn an annual bonus.
* Great career growth and development opportunities in a global organization
* A flexible approach to work

There are plenty of amazing opportunities at Convera for talented, creative problem solvers who never settle for good enough and are looking to transform Business to Business payments. Apply now if you're ready to unleash your potential.
