Overview:

We are looking for a Technical Product Manager to deliver Business Observability and AIOps initiatives for the Value Stream Monitoring (VSM) team. You will work with Observability Architects, engineering teams, partners and business stakeholders to plan and deliver the end to end monitoring of critical business processes important for Pepsico’s business.

Responsibilities:

* Plan, track and deliver Business Observability and AIOps projects end to end.
* Turn architecture designs (Event Management, CMDB, Discovery, Service Mapping) into clear project plans and roadmaps.
* Coordinate monitoring tool integrations such as AppDynamics, Grafana, Elastic and other monitoring tools.
* Onboard new business processes across sectors, through to handover to the sustain team.
* Deliver service health dashboards, KPI reports and executive status updates.
* Track outcomes such as MTTD/MTTR improvement, alert noise reduction and business value delivered.
* Manage risks, dependencies and issues, and escalate when needed.
* Run Agile ceremonies and governance forums with engineering, operations, vendors and business teams.
* Support adoption of automation, self-healing and AI/GenAI use cases
* Drive new integrations part of common services framework.
* Enable new uses cases

Qualifications:

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 10+ years in IT, including 5+ years as a Technical Project or Program Manager.
* Experience delivering observability, monitoring, ITOM or AIOps projects.
* Working knowledge of ServiceNow ITOM (Event Management, CMDB, CSDM, Discovery, Service Mapping).
* Good understanding of ITSM IPC processes and operational metrics (MTTD, MTTR).
* Hands-on Agile/Scrum experience and comfort working with multiple vendors.
* Clear communicator who can explain technical progress to senior leaders.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* PMP, SAFe, CSM or ITIL certification.
* Exposure to AI/GenAI in IT operations.
* Experience with business process monitoring in CPG, supply chain or order management.

This role primarily owns

**Area**

**Scope**

PGT SAP integrations

Bring SAP processes delivered through PGT into VSM monitoring; define the business events, KPIs and thresholds to watch; align integration timelines with PGT deployments

IAM

Integrate identity and access signals that affect business process health (for example access failures that block order or transaction flows), and make sure VSM itself meets access and security standards

D&AI

Partner with Data & AI on data feeds, analytics and AI/ML use cases (anomaly detection, predictive alerting, RCA insights) that strengthen VSM

Future platform and partner teams

Set up a repeatable intake and integration model so new capability groups can onboard to VSM with clear standards

VSM platform support

Drive platform health, releases, enhancements and issue resolution with engineering and vendor teams

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Owner (ePI)
job_description:
**About the Team:**

Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise.

Enterprise Systems Management & Business Operations delivers digital solutions that support Enterprise Systems running as a high-performing organisation. This team drives financial discipline, operational rigour and strategic alignment across the ES portfolio that safeguard GSK’s integrity and reputation globally. By joining this team, you’ll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward.

**Job Purpose:**

* The Senior Product Owner (ePI) is responsible for maximising the value of Electronic Product Information by translating regulatory and operational business needs into a prioritised backlog and leading delivery across a complex product ecosystem. The role ensures that regulatory- and process-driven changes are delivered within applicable GxP, compliance, data-use and data-access requirements and within strategic and financial guardrails agreed with the Product Manager in line with Tech leadership direction. Working closely with business stakeholders and external partners, the Product Owner defines outcomes and ensures delivered functionality is usable, secure, compliant, supportable and aligned to product strategy.
* The Senior Product Owner (ePI) guides Product Analysts and works with Engineers, Architects, Testers, Service teams and external partners to ensure requirements are clear, value-driven and data-informed. The job holder makes day-to-day backlog and acceptance decisions, oversees iterative delivery and uses product performance information to improve adoption, stability, user experience and operational readiness.
* The role is accountable for maintaining clarity of scope and decision making throughout discovery, refinement, design, testing, release and operation. Strategic investment, major architecture and cross-product trade-offs that exceed delegated authority are escalated to the Product Manager, who coordinates further escalation to the Product Domain Lead or Tech leadership team in line with agreed decision rights.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Partner with business stakeholders to understand functional needs, refine requirements and define product outcomes and maintain alignment throughout delivery.
* Lead end-to-end product delivery across the complex ePI ecosystem, guiding Product Analysts and coordinating Engineers, Architects, Testers, enterprise platform teams and external partners to ensure solutions are fit for purpose, secure, compliant, supportable and aligned to applicable standards.
* Ensure ePI product changes, including regulatory-driven changes, comply with applicable GxP, security, data-use, data-access, privacy, quality, validation, change and regulatory controls, obtaining specialist approvals where required.
* Own and manage the product backlog, ensuring epics, features and user stories are well defined and supported by relevant data on value, users, cost, risk, dependencies and process impact.
* Use AI tools to draft requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria and summaries of stakeholder input, and have the output reviewed before it enters the backlog.
* Make backlog prioritisation decisions based on value, cost, risk, business continuity and resource capacity, escalating strategic trade-offs in line with the agreed RACI.
* Lead refinement, demonstrations, acceptance and release decisions and maintain clear traceability from business outcome through requirement, test and delivered change.
* Drive operational readiness using a structured checklist covering support model, training, continuity, configuration, runbooks, release notes, validation evidence and user onboarding.
* Define and maintain the product performance dashboard, tracking adoption, process outcomes, cycle time, stability, defects, user experience and support effort.
* Support Architects in assessing design options and manage cross-product dependencies, interface impacts and release sequencing.
* Build working knowledge of the ePI platforms and, with guidance, identify straightforward improvement opportunities, such as regulatory-change automation, and flag them to the Product Manager for assessment.
* Act as an escalation point for the product team and business users on functional product issues and guide resolution within agreed guardrails.
* Coordinate supplier delivery and hold external partners accountable for quality, documentation, knowledge transfer and product outcomes.
* Promote agile, iterative, value-driven and data-led delivery and use feedback and performance insights to continuously improve the product.

**Basic Requirements:**

**Education & Professional Qualifications:**

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Life Sciences or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

**Area of Specialisation**

* Product ownership and product lifecycle management
* Requirements, backlog and acceptance management
* Agile and iterative delivery
* User-centred design and adoption
* Product performance, operational readiness and continuous improvement
* Enterprise technology, data, integration, security and service principles
* Understanding of regulated manufacturing, supply chain, quality or laboratory environments
* The role requires sufficient technical, analytical and business understanding to translate operational needs into controlled product changes. The education or equivalent experience enables the job holder to evaluate value, feasibility, process impact, data, risk, security, compliance and support implications and to communicate clearly with business and technology specialists.

**Job-Related Experience:**

* Minimum Level of Job-Related Experience Required
* Typically 5+ years of experience in product ownership, business analysis, digital solutions, technology delivery or process-led technology roles.
* Proven experience defining and prioritising epics, features, user stories and acceptance criteria and managing a product backlog.
* Exposure to AI tooling used for discovery, refinement or drafting, with human review of outputs before they enter the backlog.
* Experience managing digital products within a complex ecosystem of business functions, regulatory stakeholders, enterprise platforms and external partners, ideally involving Electronic Product Information or comparable regulatory-driven solutions.
* Experience working directly with business stakeholders to translate needs into feasible, value-led technology changes.
* Demonstrated ability to prioritise based on value, process impact, risk, cost, capacity and technology dependencies.
* Experience guiding Product Analysts, Engineers, Architects and Testers through refinement, design, testing, release and adoption.
* Experience applying GxP, security, data protection, data-use and data-access restrictions, quality, validation, change and service-readiness controls in a regulated environment.
* Experience defining product performance measures and using user, process, stability and service insights to improve outcomes.
* Experience working in agile or iterative delivery environments and coordinating suppliers or external delivery partners.

**Preferred:**

* Product ownership, agile delivery, business analysis, change, process improvement or service management certifications are desirable.

**Skills**

Change Management, Compliance Risk Management, Executive Reports, Financial Acumen, Portfolio Performance Management, Portfolio Prioritization, Problem Solving, Project Management Governance, Shareholder Communications

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

Working closely with business stakeholders and external partners, the Product Owner defines outcomes and ensures delivered functionality is usable, secure, compliant, supportable and aligned to product strategy.
* The Senior Product Owner (ePI) guides Product Analysts and works with Engineers, Architects, Testers, Service teams and external partners to ensure requirements are clear, value-driven and data-informed. The job holder makes day-to-day backlog and acceptance decisions, oversees iterative delivery and uses product performance information to improve adoption, stability, user experience and operational readiness.
* The role is accountable for maintaining clarity of scope and decision making throughout discovery, refinement, design, testing, release and operation. Strategic investment, major architecture and cross-product trade-offs that exceed delegated authority are escalated to the Product Manager, who coordinates further escalation to the Product Domain Lead or Tech leadership team in line with agreed decision rights.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Partner with business stakeholders to understand functional needs, refine requirements and define product outcomes and maintain alignment throughout delivery.
* Lead end-to-end product delivery across the complex ePI ecosystem, guiding Product Analysts and coordinating Engineers, Architects, Testers, enterprise platform teams and external partners to ensure solutions are fit for purpose, secure, compliant, supportable and aligned to applicable standards.
* Ensure ePI product changes, including regulatory-driven changes, comply with applicable GxP, security, data-use, data-access, privacy, quality, validation, change and regulatory controls, obtaining specialist approvals where required.
* Own and manage the product backlog, ensuring epics, features and user stories are well defined and supported by relevant data on value, users, cost, risk, dependencies and process impact.
* Use AI tools to draft requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria and summaries of stakeholder input, and have the output reviewed before it enters the backlog.
* Make backlog prioritisation decisions based on value, cost, risk, business continuity and resource capacity, escalating strategic trade-offs in line with the agreed RACI.
* Lead refinement, demonstrations, acceptance and release decisions and maintain clear traceability from business outcome through requirement, test and delivered change.
* Drive operational readiness using a structured checklist covering support model, training, continuity, configuration, runbooks, release notes, validation evidence and user onboarding.
* Define and maintain the product performance dashboard, tracking adoption, process outcomes, cycle time, stability, defects, user experience and support effort.
* Support Architects in assessing design options and manage cross-product dependencies, interface impacts and release sequencing.
* Build working knowledge of the ePI platforms and, with guidance, identify straightforward improvement opportunities, such as regulatory-change automation, and flag them to the Product Manager for assessment.
* Act as an escalation point for the product team and business users on functional product issues and guide resolution within agreed guardrails.
* Coordinate supplier delivery and hold external partners accountable for quality, documentation, knowledge transfer and product outcomes.
* Promote agile, iterative, value-driven and data-led delivery and use feedback and performance insights to continuously improve the product.

**Basic Requirements:**

**Education & Professional Qualifications:**

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Life Sciences or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

**Area of Specialisation**

* Product ownership and product lifecycle management
* Requirements, backlog and acceptance management
* Agile and iterative delivery
* User-centred design and adoption
* Product performance, operational readiness and continuous improvement
* Enterprise technology, data, integration, security and service principles
* Understanding of regulated manufacturing, supply chain, quality or laboratory environments
* The role requires sufficient technical, analytical and business understanding to translate operational needs into controlled product changes. The education or equivalent experience enables the job holder to evaluate value, feasibility, process impact, data, risk, security, compliance and support implications and to communicate clearly with business and technology specialists.

**Job-Related Experience:**

* Minimum Level of Job-Related Experience Required
* Typically 5+ years of experience in product ownership, business analysis, digital solutions, technology delivery or process-led technology roles.
* Proven experience defining and prioritising epics, features, user stories and acceptance criteria and managing a product backlog.
* Exposure to AI tooling used for discovery, refinement or drafting, with human review of outputs before they enter the backlog.
* Experience managing digital products within a complex ecosystem of business functions, regulatory stakeholders, enterprise platforms and external partners, ideally involving Electronic Product Information or comparable regulatory-driven solutions.
* Experience working directly with business stakeholders to translate needs into feasible, value-led technology changes.
* Demonstrated ability to prioritise based on value, process impact, risk, cost, capacity and technology dependencies.
* Experience guiding Product Analysts, Engineers, Architects and Testers through refinement, design, testing, release and adoption.
* Experience applying GxP, security, data protection, data-use and data-access restrictions, quality, validation, change and service-readiness controls in a regulated environment.
* Experience defining product performance measures and using user, process, stability and service insights to improve outcomes.
* Experience working in agile or iterative delivery environments and coordinating suppliers or external delivery partners.

**Preferred:**

* Product ownership, agile delivery, business analysis, change, process improvement or service management certifications are desirable.

**Skills**

Change Management, Compliance Risk Management, Executive Reports, Financial Acumen, Portfolio Performance Management, Portfolio Prioritization, Problem Solving, Project Management Governance, Shareholder Communications

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

* R024187

* Pune, Maharashtra, India

* IT Operations

* Regular

  

**Location Details:**India, Remote

At GoDaddy the future of work looks different for each team. Some teams work in the office full-time, others have a hybrid arrangement (they work remotely some days and in the office some days) and some work entirely remotely.

This is a remote position, so you’ll be working remotely from your home. You may occasionally visit a GoDaddy office to meet with your team for events or meetings.

#### **Join our team**

GoDaddy, the world's largest domain name registrar, helps millions of entrepreneurs globally start, grow, and scale their businesses. People come to GoDaddy to name their idea, build a website and logo, sell their products and services, and accept payments. Airo™, our agentic operating system for small businesses, helps entrepreneurs get their idea online, run their business day-to-day, and grow through an integrated identity, presence, and commerce experience.

Domains are where many of those journeys begin. We have over 20 million customers and manage more than 80 million domains. Beyond registration, we run a domain aftermarket for investors and businesses that want to buy or sell a name. **Afternic** is one of the world's largest domain marketplaces, and GoDaddy Auctions is a leading marketplace for expired domains.

As a Senior Product Manager, you'll work on a range of customer problems for both independent entrepreneurs getting their business online and domain investors who buy and sell names at scale. Are you interested in this opportunity? We'd love to hear from you!

#### **What you'll get to do...**

* Own and deliver against your squad's Key Results, from problem framing through launch and readout. Learn fast. Ship frequently and set clear assessment criteria before you build
* Stay close to customers. Talk with them, review their feedback, and let their problems set your priorities
* Design and run experiments. Write clear hypotheses, partner with engineering and design to ship quickly, and interpret results honestly. Not every release will produce a statistically significant result. We expect you to find sound ways to measure what's hard to measure, so you know whether a release is moving your goals in the right direction and whether it hurts other key areas
* Use AI as a tool. Apply it to data analysis, UX design iteration, prototyping, and code where it fits, and apply your own judgment to the output
* Partner across time zones with engineering, design, marketing, and support. Communicate clearly in writing and keep decisions visible

#### **Your experience should include...**

* 6+ years of product management experience, with a track record of shipping measurable results
* Experience running A/B tests or other experiments from hypothesis to decision
* Adaptability and comfort with ambiguity and growth mindset that thrives on learning and continuous improvement – progress over perfection
* Skill in pulling relevant data yourself and interpreting it and practical AI fluency. You can describe where it helped you and where you chose not to rely on it
* Strong written and async communication, and comfort working with teammates that we have in other time zones with a focus on solving customer problems over shipping features

**You might also have...**

* Marketplace experience
* Experience with domains, web presence, or e-commerce
* Experience building for small business owners who are growing online
* Experience with financial or investing tools

*We encourage you to apply even if your experience or skillset doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement. We value a wide range of backgrounds and transferable skills, and we are excited to support learning and growth.*

**We've got your back...**We offer a range of total rewards that may include paid time off, retirement savings (e.g., 401k, pension schemes), bonus/incentive eligibility, equity grants, participation in our employee stock purchase plan, competitive health benefits, and other family-friendly benefits including parental leave. GoDaddy’s benefits vary based on individual role and location and can be reviewed in more detail during the interview process.

**About us...** GoDaddy is empowering everyday entrepreneurs around the world by providing the help and tools to succeed online, making opportunity more inclusive for all. GoDaddy is the place people come to name their idea, build a professional website, attract customers, sell their products and services, and manage their work. Our mission is to give our customers the tools, insights, and people to transform their ideas and personal initiative into success. To learn more about the company, visit About Us.

At GoDaddy, we know diverse teams build better products—period. Our people and culture reflect and celebrate that sense of diversity and inclusion in ideas, experiences and perspectives. But we also know that’s not enough to build true equity and belonging in our communities. That’s why we prioritize integrating diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging principles into the core of how we work every day—focusing not only on our employee experience, but also our customer experience and operations. It’s the best way to serve our mission of empowering entrepreneurs everywhere, and making opportunity more inclusive for all. To read more about these commitments, as well as our representation and pay equity data, check out our Diversity and Pay Parity annual report which can be found on our Diversity Careers page.

We also embrace our diverse culture and offer a range of Employee Resource Groups (Culture). Have a side hustle? No problem. We love entrepreneurs! Most importantly, come as you are and make your own way.

*GoDaddy is proud to be an equal opportunity employer**.* *GoDaddy will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with local and federal requirements.* *Refer to our full* *EEO policy.*

Our recruiting team is available to assist you in completing your application. If they could be helpful, please reach out to myrecruiter@godaddy.com.

**GoDaddy doesn’t accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies.**

job_description:
**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Job Title: IT Product Owner**

**Corporate Title: Vice President**

**Location: Pune, India**

**Role Description**

* Guide team members in adopting Scrum principles and practices and help them improve their skills and collaboration.
* Foster a positive and productive team environment, encouraging open communication, conflict resolution, and collaboration.
* Empower team members to take ownership of their work, make decisions, and solve problems.
* Facilitate knowledge sharing and skill development within the team and encourage collaboration with other teams.
* Help team members provide and receive constructive feedback and facilitate continuous improvement efforts.
* Help resolve conflicts and impediments that may arise within the team and facilitate open discussions to find solutions.
* Facilitate communication and collaboration between the team and stakeholders, ensuring that expectations are aligned and managed.
The role may not have a direct Line Management initially; however, the people skills are critical to be successful in this role.  

  

**What we’ll offer you**

As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy,

* Best in class leave policy.
* Gender neutral parental leaves
* 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
* Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
* Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
* Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
* Accident and Term life Insurance
Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above  

**Your key responsibilities**

* Develop, Create, and communicate Product Vision and Roadmap with the Business Owners, Delivery Teams & Solution/System Architects
* Serves as the strategic Product Owner for driving the transition toward Strategic Data warehousing solutions on Google Cloud (GCP)
* Translate business objectives, regulatory expectations, and investigative needs into a prioritized product roadmap that enables compliance, efficiency, and risk reduction
* Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to align feature development with business priorities and migration milestones
* Ensure development work is tightly aligned to user value and strategic goals
* Own the product vision for the migration working closely with several teams to define integration points, decommissioning timelines and MVP delivery plans
* Monitor and track the progress of the platform transition, proactively resolving blockers, refining scope, and communicating impact to leadership and delivery teams
* Champion continuous improvement across Agile ways of working, contributing to velocity gains, improved stakeholder visibility and enhanced delivery predictability
* Act as a change leader, supporting business readiness, user adoption, and training efforts to ensure successful platform onboarding and operational continuity
* Define and Communicate Product Vision and roadmap in partnership with stakeholders and engineering
* Develop as an SME and primary point of contact liaison with all relevant stakeholders in Business and Engineering, giving them timely, transparent, and metric driven updates.
* Ensure adherence to both the Bank’s and domain’s testing standards with focus on achieving further efficiencies and benefits through automated testing.
* Provide management, leadership, and technical/domain guidance to teams across multiple locations and senior escalation point for all stakeholders.
Participate in the end-to-end development cycle working closely with squad teams following the domain’s development model.  

**Your skills and experience**

**Technical / Domain Skills**

* 10+ years’ experience as Product Owner and Product management in an agile environment
* 8+ years’ experience working in data warehousing projects executed On Google cloud environment.
* Avaloq Core banking experience preferred
* Technical skills include - Data warehousing concepts, Google cloud platform – BigQuery, Cloud SQL, Cloud composer, GKE, pipelines set up using DataProc, Python
* Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to communicate at all levels of seniority with proven experience in successfully driving roadmaps and delivery of large-scale Regulatory, Risk, Data or Transformation Programs
* Proven experience and evidencing prioritization techniques, refinement, grooming and challenges with the Backlog management.
* Knowledge and experience of Finance domain. Good to have experience in any phase of Transaction Monitoring and Reporting, and / or Private Banking.
* Experience with Agile Testing & Engineering techniques would be a plus
* Experience with JIRA and Confluence
Experience in using AI Tools to achieve increased productivity  

**Soft Skills**

* Agile & Product mindset
* Strong Analytical skills
* Ability to work in virtual teams and in matrix organizations
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
Evidence of Team Player, Mentoring or driving Team objectives  

  

**Education/ Qualifications**

* Bachelor of Science degree from an accredited college or university with a concentration in Computer Science or Software Engineering (or equivalent) – with a minor in Finance, Mathematics or Engineering.

Good to have: Product owner/Product Manager/ Business Analyst Certifications from recognized institutes/ courses.  

  

**Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.**

**How we’ll support you**

* Training and development to help you excel in your career.
* Coaching and support from experts in your team.
* A culture of continuous learning to aid progression.
A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs.  

**About us and our teams**

Please visit our company website for further information:

**https://www.db.com/company/company.html**

We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.

Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.

We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

title: Product Manager II
job_description:
**Title:** Senior Product Manager

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Product Vision & Strategy:** Own and execute the multi-year product roadmap, aligning product goals with company-wide commercial objectives and market demands.
* **Portfolio & Lifecycle Management:** Oversee end-to-end product delivery—from market research, discovery, and business case development to launch, scaling, and lifecycle optimization.
* **Team Leadership & Mentorship:** Lead, hire, and mentor a team of Product Managers and Senior Product Managers, fostering a high-ownership, data-driven culture.
* **Cross-Functional Alignment:** Partner with Engineering, Architecture, UX/Design, Sales, Marketing, and Finance to remove roadblocks, prioritize trade-offs, and accelerate execution.
* **Data & Experimentation:** Champion hypothesis-driven decision-making, utilizing analytics, customer feedback loops, and key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure impact.
* **Executive & Stakeholder Management:** Present strategic recommendations, business cases, and portfolio updates to C-suite executives and board-level stakeholders.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* **Experience:** 10+ years of total professional experience, with at least 7–8 years of direct experience in Product Management building and scaling software or enterprise/B2C products.
* **People Management:** 4+ years of formal experience managing, coaching, and developing Product Managers.
* **Strategic & Technical Acumen:** Deep understanding of modern product development methodologies, SaaS/enterprise architectures, and emerging technologies (such as AI/ML workflows or data-driven platforms).
* **Business Orientation:** Proven track record of tying product decisions to revenue growth, cost reduction, retention, or customer lifetime value.

**Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related technical/analytical field (MBA preferred).

* **Business Orientation:** Proven track record of tying product decisions to revenue growth, cost reduction, retention, or customer lifetime value.

**Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related technical/analytical field (MBA preferred).

title: Senior Product Manager AI - Bangalore
job_description:
Role - Senior Product Manager || Job Location - Bangalore
  
  
About the Role
  
  
We are looking for a dynamic and experienced Product Manager / Senior Product Manager – AI to lead the strategy, development, and implementation of AI-driven products that transform customer and merchant experiences across our payments ecosystem. The role will work closely with Engineering, Data Science, Compliance, and Business teams to develop next-generation solutions powered by large language models (LLMs) and other generative AI technologies.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Define and drive the roadmap for generative AI capabilities across our product suite, including fraud detection, customer support automation, and personalised payment experiences.
  
Work cross-functionally with AI/ML Engineers, Data Scientists, UX Designers, and business stakeholders to build, launch, and iterate on AI-powered features.
  
Identify customer pain points and develop AI-first product solutions that improve efficiency, security, and user engagement.
  
Evaluate third-party LLM platforms, including OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google, and work with internal teams to integrate them securely and effectively.
  
Monitor product performance using data and customer feedback, and use insights to optimise AI models and user interactions.
  
Ensure that all AI product developments comply with applicable financial regulations and data privacy laws, including RBI and GDPR requirements.
  
  
Required Qualifications
  
  
5–8 years of product management experience, including at least 1+ year of experience in AI products; experience in payments or fintech is highly preferred.
  
Strong understanding of generative AI models, including LLMs, transformers, and embeddings, and their applications in real-world products.
  
Proven track record of shipping B2C or B2B AI/ML-driven products at scale.
  
Strong analytical, strategic-thinking, and communication skills.
  
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment with regulatory sensitivity.
  
  
Nice to Have
  
  
Experience with prompt engineering and fine-tuning LLMs.
  
Background in Data Science, Machine Learning, or Software Engineering.
  
Familiarity with payment ecosystems, risk modelling, and fraud analytics.
  
  
About PayU
  
  
At PayU, we’re building a world without financial borders where everyone can prosper. As a global fintech investor operating in 18+ high-growth markets, we extend financial services to underserved populations, help merchants thrive online, and invest in innovative financial technology. As part of Prosus, one of the world’s largest technology investors, we combine global expertise with local market knowledge to create meaningful impact. Learn more at www.payu.com
  
  
Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion
  
  
PayU fosters an environment where everyone belongs regardless of gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, or religious belief. Our leadership is committed to creating a transparent, flexible workplace where every voice matters and all PayUneers can succeed. We have zero tolerance for discrimination and actively promote equal opportunities across our global organization.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager (B2B)
job_description:
**About Refold AI**

Refold AI is the AI integration platform built for agents, made for modern SaaS companies that need to ship enterprise integrations at scale. We're reimagining integrations with AI agents that work like business consultants and integration engineers, building them 10x faster, in hours instead of days. The payoff: integrations stop being a bottleneck that costs you deals and burns margin, and become a growth engine. You win the enterprise deals that hinge on them, onboard faster, and scale without an army of consultants.

We've grown rapidly, reaching seven-figure ARR and 30+ paying customers, powering the product and professional services teams at modern SaaS companies, from Incorta, Kantata, and Coupa to Highradius, Naehas, and OvationCXM.

Refold AI has raised $6.5M from world-class investors including Eniac Ventures (early investors in Airbnb & Uber), Tidal Ventures, and Better Capital.

**What you'll do:**

* Where does automation earn trust, and where does a human still need to stay in the loop?
* You will draw that line repeatedly, and the answer will keep changing. How do you price outcomes instead of usage, in an industry that has only ever paid for hours?
* You will own that question commercially and build the model around it. What does it mean for a platform to get smarter across customers without leaking what any one customer knows?
* You will define what learning looks like at the system level.
* How do ISV developers think about reliability when their customers depend on
* integrations running without anyone watching? You will own that experience end to end.
* When something breaks in production for an enterprise customer, who gets told, what do they see, and what can they do about it? You will design that judgment layer.

**What we're looking for:**

* You have shipped something on your own. A side project, a tool, anything you took from zero to working. We are building systems with real complexity. We need someone who has felt the difference between a decision made in a doc and a decision made in code.
* You are technically grounded. You do not write the code, but you understand the structure, the trade-offs, and the failure modes. When engineering says a change costs 40% more compute, you know what that means downstream.
* You think in constraints. When you look at a feature request, the first question is what breaks if we build this, not what we could do with it. Edge cases are not polish. They are often the product.
* You write, not deck. Specs, trade-off docs, design decisions. If you cannot write a crisp two-page spec, the feature is not ready to build.
* You push back. If the scoping is underspecified, say so. If the deadline is not realistic, say so. Disagree clearly and commit once a decision is made

**Experience**

* 5+ years in product in the B2B software industry
* At least 2 of those years on a platform, infrastructure, or developer tool.
* Comfortable with distributed systems concepts: queues, retries, schema versioning, idempotency
* Track record of shipping things that were actually hard, not feature additions on a stable roadmap
* Degree from a top-tier institution, or hands-on product experience at a company known for building hard things. One or the other, not neither.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
**Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.**

**The Opportunity**
===================

As a Senior Product Manager on the pricing team, you will help drive topline growth of our hybrid multicloud and AI-ready infrastructure portfolio by driving improvements across the Quote to Cash (Q2C) process to ensure Nutanix software is priced, quoted, and fulfilled seamlessly across channel partners, OEMs, and Cloud Marketplaces.

Tackling challenges that directly impact company revenue, you will secure executive buy-in and guide engineering execution. A pivotal part of this role involves

* Driving enhancements to Salesforce and our CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote) platform to deliver a frictionless experience for our sellers and partners.
* Building agentic AI workflows that automate pricing operations and SKU lifecycle management

If you thrive at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Finance, and Go-to-Market and possess sharp business acumen, we want to talk to you.

**About the Team**

At Nutanix, we are simplifying cloud complexity. The Pricing and Monetization Team acts as the commercial compass of the company, defining how our solutions are bundled, priced, and consumed globally across all routes to market.

Operating at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Finance, and Go-to-Market, our work touches almost every function in the company and has a direct, high impact on the company’s top line. We set price points and set discounting policies across geographies and routes to market. We manage the lifecycle of Nutanix pricebooks. We drive continuous enhancements across our Quote to Cash (Q2C) , fulfillment and renewals workflows and platforms to ensure our customers and partners have a great experience buying and using Nutanix products.

We are a highly collaborative, globally distributed team based in India and the US West Coast. We champion a culture of shared learning, absolute project ownership, and deep cross-functional partnership. Above all, we operate with clarity of purpose, transparent communication, and a ruthless focus on delivering results.

**Your Role and responsibilities**
==================================

* Manage SKU lifecycle , pricebook lifecycle and Quote to cash (Q2C) workflows across geographies and routes to market.
* Use AI agents to manage existing workflows and automate new workflows as business needs evolve.
* Drive cross functional alignment with Revenue Operations, Support and Finance and translate business requirements into clearly defined PRDs and use cases.
* Collaborate closely with engineering to ensure requirements are fully understood, technically feasible and delivered accurately.
* The role involves performing duties requiring the application of professional expertise and the exercise of independent judgment/discretion, creativity, problem-solving, and decision-making in carrying out responsibilities, as applicable to the position. The specific responsibilities of the role may vary based on business needs and role requirements. Employees can refer to the applicable guidelines and career frameworks for additional information regarding role expectations and responsibilities.

**What You Will Bring**
=======================

* Proven experience in designing, deploying and managing AI agents and LLM-driven workflows to automate business processes and software testing cycles.
* Deep understanding of B2B sales systems, Quote to Cash (Q2C) process, Enterprise software renewals and SKU lifecycle management.
* 5+ years of relevant professional experience in Product Management, Strategy consulting or building IT systems or business platforms for Enterprise software sales.
* Exceptional communication and presentation skills to simplify complex requirements.
* Collaboration with a large number of organizations to align on ideas and execute projects..
* Degree in Business or STEM
* **Work Arrangement**

  **Hybrid****: This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in-person collaboration. In locations where our workplace policy applies (i.e. San Jose, Durham, Mexico City, Bangalore, Pune, Hoofddorp, Belgrade, Barcelona, Singapore, Sydney and Tokyo), employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of 3 days per week to foster collaboration, team alignment, and access to in-office resources. Workplace type may vary based on location and team requirements. Please speak with your recruiter for details. Additional team-specific guidance and norms will be provided by your manager.**

title: Senior Product Manager - Historian and Visualisation
job_description:
**About the Team:**

Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, (Workplace & Real Estate Facilities)WREF, CGA (Communications & Government Affairs) and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise. Enterprise Systems Management & Business Operations delivers digital solutions that support Enterprise Systems running as a high-performing organisation. This team drives financial discipline, operational rigour and strategic alignment across the ES portfolio that safeguard GSK’s integrity and reputation globally. By joining this team, you’ll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward.  
  
**Job Purpose:**  
  
The Senior Product Manager - Historian and Visualisation is responsible for the delivery, configuration, support, and continuous improvement of GSK's IP21, A1PE, Historian, reporting, and visualization platforms. The role translates manufacturing, engineering, and operational requirements into technical solutions that enable reliable, secure, compliant, and scalable manufacturing data management. Working with manufacturing sites, (Manufacturing Execution System) MES teams, Engineers, Architects, Quality/Validation, Service teams, and external partners, the Product Engineer designs, configures, integrates, tests, validates, and supports historian and visualization solutions aligned with global standards and product roadmaps. The role manages technical backlogs, supports requirements analysis, coordinates system integrations and data flows, and ensures data integrity, cybersecurity, performance, and platform reliability across the manufacturing technology landscape. Leverage AI-assisted tools to configure, test, and document IP21/A1PE solutions, ensuring all AI-generated outputs are validated for accuracy, data integrity, security, and (Good Practice) GxP compliance prior to release. Deliver reliable historian and visualization solutions that support manufacturing operations and business objectives.

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Own the design of IP21/A1PE solutions and integrations within the approved architecture, translating business requirements into scalable technical solutions, making and documenting design decisions, and ensuring alignment with architectural, operational, security, and compliance standards.
* Maintain IP21/A1PE engineering standards and reusable configuration patterns and provide technical guidance and lead engineers to ensure consistent, scalable, and supportable solutions.
* Partner with stakeholders to translate manufacturing, engineering and data requirements into IP21 solutions and improvements, and manage and prioritize the IP21 backlog based on business value, risk, compliance and operational needs.
* Deliver historian capabilities by collaborating with Engineers, Architects, MES teams and vendors.
* Monitor system performance, data quality and user adoption, driving continuous improvement.
* Ensure operational readiness through documentation, training, support and validation activities, and ensure compliance with cybersecurity, data integrity, quality and regulatory requirements.
* Define, test, validate and release IP21 changes, ensuring traceability and compliance, and manage integration and dependencies between IP21, MES, A1PE and other manufacturing systems.
* Support issue resolution, system maintenance and ongoing platform optimization.
* Coordinate supplier activities and leverage data and AI-enabled tools to improve delivery, support and business value
* Use AI-assisted tools as the default way of configuring, scripting, testing and documenting IP21/A1PE changes, and validate all AI-generated output for accuracy, data integrity, security and GxP before release.

**Basic Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Life Sciences or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Experience in making technical and product configuration decisions that impact data integrity, operational visibility and business performance, including managing priorities, collaborating with cross-functional teams and delivering historian and visualization solutions that meet reliability, security, compliance and user requirements.
* Minimum 5+ years of experience in product ownership, business analysis, digital solutions, technology delivery or process-led technology roles.
* Experience in industrial data historian systems (for example, Aspen IP21, A1PE, OSI PI Historian or similar platforms), data visualization platforms and manufacturing reporting solutions within manufacturing, pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical or other regulated environments.
* Experience in developing and supporting real-time dashboards, reports, trends and analytics solutions that enable operational monitoring and decision-making.
* Experience in working with process, production, quality and equipment data from MES, SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition), automation, historian and enterprise systems.
* Experience in data analysis, data modelling, data integration and data management for operational and business reporting.
* Experience in configuring and supporting historian and visualization applications, including performance optimisation and troubleshooting.
* Experience in integrating historian and visualization platforms with MES, ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning), laboratory and other enterprise systems, including use of industrial connectivity technologies and protocols such as OPC UA (Unified Architecture), OPC HDA (Historical Data Access) or similar standards.
* Experience in SQL (Structured Query Language), databases, reporting tools and data analytics technologies.
* Experience in gathering business requirements and translating them into reporting, dashboard and visualization solutions.
* Experience in working in Agile and cross-functional teams, collaborating with business stakeholders, engineers and support teams.
* Experience in supporting system validation, data integrity, compliance and change management processes in GxP-compliant or other regulated environments.
* Experience in analysing operational data to identify opportunities for process improvement and optimisation.
* Experience in using AI-enabled tools for data analysis, documentation, troubleshooting and decision support, including validating AI-generated outputs, understanding AI limitations and maintaining accountability for data quality, security, GxP compliance and product decisions.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Experience in written and verbal communication, including explaining product decisions and technology constraints to non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience in architecture, integration, data, security, validation, service and operational readiness.
* Experience in organising work, maintaining traceability and applying consistent documentation practices.
* Experience in working across global, cross-functional and supplier teams in a collaborative way.
* Experience in designing and delivering user-centred, capability-led and technology-agnostic solutions.

**Skills**

Agile Methodology, API Management, CI/CD, Cloud Based Services, Computer Programming, Configuration Management (CM), Containerization, Database Management, High Availability (Inactive), Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Microservices Architecture, Network Security, Operating Systems (OS), System Monitors, Version Control System

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

The Senior Product Manager - Historian and Visualisation is responsible for the delivery, configuration, support, and continuous improvement of GSK's IP21, A1PE, Historian, reporting, and visualization platforms. The role translates manufacturing, engineering, and operational requirements into technical solutions that enable reliable, secure, compliant, and scalable manufacturing data management. Working with manufacturing sites, (Manufacturing Execution System) MES teams, Engineers, Architects, Quality/Validation, Service teams, and external partners, the Product Engineer designs, configures, integrates, tests, validates, and supports historian and visualization solutions aligned with global standards and product roadmaps. The role manages technical backlogs, supports requirements analysis, coordinates system integrations and data flows, and ensures data integrity, cybersecurity, performance, and platform reliability across the manufacturing technology landscape. Leverage AI-assisted tools to configure, test, and document IP21/A1PE solutions, ensuring all AI-generated outputs are validated for accuracy, data integrity, security, and (Good Practice) GxP compliance prior to release. Deliver reliable historian and visualization solutions that support manufacturing operations and business objectives.

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Own the design of IP21/A1PE solutions and integrations within the approved architecture, translating business requirements into scalable technical solutions, making and documenting design decisions, and ensuring alignment with architectural, operational, security, and compliance standards.
* Maintain IP21/A1PE engineering standards and reusable configuration patterns and provide technical guidance and lead engineers to ensure consistent, scalable, and supportable solutions.
* Partner with stakeholders to translate manufacturing, engineering and data requirements into IP21 solutions and improvements, and manage and prioritize the IP21 backlog based on business value, risk, compliance and operational needs.
* Deliver historian capabilities by collaborating with Engineers, Architects, MES teams and vendors.
* Monitor system performance, data quality and user adoption, driving continuous improvement.
* Ensure operational readiness through documentation, training, support and validation activities, and ensure compliance with cybersecurity, data integrity, quality and regulatory requirements.
* Define, test, validate and release IP21 changes, ensuring traceability and compliance, and manage integration and dependencies between IP21, MES, A1PE and other manufacturing systems.
* Support issue resolution, system maintenance and ongoing platform optimization.
* Coordinate supplier activities and leverage data and AI-enabled tools to improve delivery, support and business value
* Use AI-assisted tools as the default way of configuring, scripting, testing and documenting IP21/A1PE changes, and validate all AI-generated output for accuracy, data integrity, security and GxP before release.

**Basic Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Life Sciences or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Experience in making technical and product configuration decisions that impact data integrity, operational visibility and business performance, including managing priorities, collaborating with cross-functional teams and delivering historian and visualization solutions that meet reliability, security, compliance and user requirements.
* Minimum 5+ years of experience in product ownership, business analysis, digital solutions, technology delivery or process-led technology roles.
* Experience in industrial data historian systems (for example, Aspen IP21, A1PE, OSI PI Historian or similar platforms), data visualization platforms and manufacturing reporting solutions within manufacturing, pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical or other regulated environments.
* Experience in developing and supporting real-time dashboards, reports, trends and analytics solutions that enable operational monitoring and decision-making.
* Experience in working with process, production, quality and equipment data from MES, SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition), automation, historian and enterprise systems.
* Experience in data analysis, data modelling, data integration and data management for operational and business reporting.
* Experience in configuring and supporting historian and visualization applications, including performance optimisation and troubleshooting.
* Experience in integrating historian and visualization platforms with MES, ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning), laboratory and other enterprise systems, including use of industrial connectivity technologies and protocols such as OPC UA (Unified Architecture), OPC HDA (Historical Data Access) or similar standards.
* Experience in SQL (Structured Query Language), databases, reporting tools and data analytics technologies.
* Experience in gathering business requirements and translating them into reporting, dashboard and visualization solutions.
* Experience in working in Agile and cross-functional teams, collaborating with business stakeholders, engineers and support teams.
* Experience in supporting system validation, data integrity, compliance and change management processes in GxP-compliant or other regulated environments.
* Experience in analysing operational data to identify opportunities for process improvement and optimisation.
* Experience in using AI-enabled tools for data analysis, documentation, troubleshooting and decision support, including validating AI-generated outputs, understanding AI limitations and maintaining accountability for data quality, security, GxP compliance and product decisions.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Experience in written and verbal communication, including explaining product decisions and technology constraints to non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience in architecture, integration, data, security, validation, service and operational readiness.
* Experience in organising work, maintaining traceability and applying consistent documentation practices.
* Experience in working across global, cross-functional and supplier teams in a collaborative way.
* Experience in designing and delivering user-centred, capability-led and technology-agnostic solutions.

**Skills**

Agile Methodology, API Management, CI/CD, Cloud Based Services, Computer Programming, Configuration Management (CM), Containerization, Database Management, High Availability (Inactive), Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Microservices Architecture, Network Security, Operating Systems (OS), System Monitors, Version Control System

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

job_description:
**#RunwiththePack**
===================

  

At Arctic Wolf, we’re on a mission to **end cyber risk** .

  

We are a global leader in security operations, helping organizations stay resilient against evolving cyber threats through industry-leading security operations, threat intelligence, and a people-first approach to cybersecurity.

  

More than 3,000 Pack members across the world work together every day to protect our customers and empower security teams with new levels of speed, accuracy, and intelligence at scale. What sets us apart is our relentless focus on our customers, innovation at scale, and a collaborative culture where talented people can do meaningful work that truly makes a difference.

  

We’re constantly looking for talented people to join the Pack and help us take our performance to the next level.

**About the Position:**
=======================

Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We’re looking for a **Senior Product Manager - Endpoint Security Cloud Platform** to be part of making that happen.

**Position Overview**

The Senior Product Manager, Endpoint Security Cloud Platform will own the cloud backend capabilities that underpin Arctic Wolf’s Endpoint Security portfolio, including administration, policy and configuration management, device registration and enrollment, and agent lifecycle management. Based in Bangalore, India, this is a technical, product-facing role that partners closely with Engineering and Architecture to define requirements, make product decisions, and deliver at scale. The role will be central to two of the team’s most significant initiatives: defining the cloud side of our unified agent strategy, consolidating four endpoint agents and two cloud backends into a single agent and a single cloud; and planning and executing the migration of several million endpoints from one cloud backend to another.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product Ownership – Cloud Platform**

* Own the product definition, roadmap, and prioritized backlog for Endpoint Security cloud backend capabilities, including administration, policy and configuration management, device registration and enrollment, multi-tenancy, and agent lifecycle management (deployment, upgrade, and health).

* Translate Endpoint Security strategy into clear product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria, partnering with Engineering and Architecture on system design, data flows, APIs, and technical trade-offs.

* Serve as product owner for one or more development teams, owning the definition, prioritization, and hygiene of the backlog from concept through delivery.

* Partner with UX to define administrator and operator workflows that are simple, scalable, and consistent across the Endpoint Security portfolio.

  

**Agent Consolidation & Cloud Migration**

* Define the cloud-side requirements for the unified agent initiative, consolidating four endpoint agents and two cloud backends into one agent and one cloud, including feature parity, data model alignment, and deprecation sequencing.

* Plan and drive the migration of several million endpoints between cloud backends, including migration strategy, phasing, rollback and risk mitigation, customer and partner impact, and success criteria.

* Work with Engineering, Managed Services, Support, and Customer Success to ensure migrations are seamless for customers, partners, and security analysts.

  

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Serve as the product point of contact for cloud platform capabilities across Engineering, Security Research, Managed Services, Support, and Customer Success.

* Ensure endpoint cloud capabilities integrate with Arctic Wolf’s broader platform and managed security services, improving analyst workflows, detection and response outcomes, and the customer experience.

* Engage directly with customers, partners, and internal users to gather first-hand requirements, validate solutions, and understand operational challenges at scale.

* Brief Endpoint Security product leadership on roadmap status, delivery plans, and risks, and provide technical input to Product Marketing as needed.

  

**Metrics & Quality**

* Define and track product success metrics for cloud platform capabilities, spanning deployment and adoption, migration progress, platform reliability and performance, product quality, and customer satisfaction.

  

**Key Qualifications**

**Experience & Expertise**

* 5+ years of product management experience, including at least 3 years as a product manager at an endpoint security vendor (EPP, EDR, or XDR).

* Demonstrated ownership of a technically complex endpoint security product through multiple stages of its lifecycle, ideally including the cloud management console or backend services that administer endpoint agents.

* Experience working in high-growth organizations with globally distributed product and engineering teams.

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

  

**Technical Acumen**

* Sufficient technical depth to make product decisions involving endpoint agents, agent-to-cloud communication, device enrollment and identity, policy distribution, telemetry pipelines, and operating-system considerations across Windows, macOS, and Linux.

* Strong understanding of cloud-native SaaS architecture, including multi-tenant services, APIs, microservices, identity and access management, and public cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.

* Ability to understand customer IT environments, company products, and services at a system, data flow, and API level.

* Hands-on experience with agile development practices and serving as product owner for engineering teams.

  

**Product Skills & EQ**

* Strong decision-making and follow-through, including defining the problem, evaluating alternatives and trade-offs, and measuring results against success criteria.

* Highly detail oriented, with the ability to manage complex dependencies across multiple teams and workstreams.

* Clear, concise written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain technical concepts to engineers, leadership, and customers.

* High EQ and a collaborative approach to partnering across functional teams and time zones.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience leading large-scale endpoint or cloud migrations, product consolidation, or re-platforming initiatives.

* Experience with device management, enrollment, or provisioning at scale (e.g., MDM/UEM or similar).

* Prior hands-on technical background, such as software engineering, solutions architecture, or sales engineering, before moving into product management.

**On-Camera Policy**

To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews. Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers. We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations.

**Benefits**
============

  

All wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including:

  

* Equity for all employees
* 18 days annual leave, flexible holidays & festivals, and paid volunteer days
* Training and career development programs
* Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical insurance for you and your family, life insurance (3x compensation), and personal accident insurance.
A modern workplace in Helios Business Park in Bengaluru  

**Security Requirements**
=========================

At Arctic Wolf, protecting our people, customers, and data is fundamental to how we operate. All employees are expected to uphold our commitment to security, privacy, and compliance by following internal information security policies, standards, and controls designed to safeguard the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of business, customer, employee, and other confidential information and to support compliance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.

Depending on the role and where permitted by applicable law, employment may be subject to background verification and additional regulatory, security, or compliance requirements, including obligations related to data protection and export control laws, and authorization requirements where applicable.

  

**Your next big opportunity starts here — apply today and help us end cyber risk.**
===================================================================================
